# Stellar Edu Consultancy

> Expert-led MBBS abroad consultancy for Indian students and families.

Stellar Edu Consultancy helps students compare MBBS abroad options, understand country and university choices, check eligibility, prepare documents, and receive practical admissions guidance.

## Important verification note

University recognition, WDOMS listing, NMC/FMGL eligibility, fee details, admissions rules, visa rules, and licensing pathways can change. Students and families should verify current information against official university and regulator sources before payment or final admission.
